title: 黑洞方块 · Black Hole Square
subtitle: 点击箭头推动方块，创造黑洞，在原始步数内清空18个谜题。

source.author: Quinten Clause
source.notes: 原作MIT引擎、18张6×6地图、步数、矢量图、星空与合成音效保留；标题Gugi轮廓注明独立OFL来源，不打包字体。关卡可自由跳过，只给真实清空记通关；保存选择、已清空与成功解法，不保存中途棋盘。新宿主/适配GPL-3.0-only。

integrationActions: Add lazy component and exactly18-level metadata to host registry/catalog.
Set resumeKey and allowUndo:false. Do not mark game campaign/endless.
Prepend node scripts/black-hole-square/build.mjs to dev/build prerequisites.
Keep generated public/games/black-hole-square/js/ and source.tar.gz ignored/reproduced in CI.
Run static independent full read before compilation or gameplay.
Use one targeted E2E invocation: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/black-hole-square.spec.ts.
After host dist, run build-identity.mjs and verify every manifest resource over HTTP.
Sync host license notices and corresponding-source index; do not describe module archive as entire host source.
